title: NPDev External AI Run Record
description: Ties a mission to its pack, its verdict (or an explicit reason it has neither), and what happened to each finding afterward (ADR-0009). This is what run-external-ai-gate.ps1 (P8) checks: a mission profile with no run record and no explicit NOT_RUN reason fails -- the same blind-spot shape the register-consistency checker was written to catch one level over.

runStatus.description: RUN requires packManifestSha256 and one of verdictRecordKind/recordKind below; NOT_RUN requires notRunReason. There is no third, silent option.

notRunReason.description: Required when runStatus is NOT_RUN, e.g. 'awaiting D1/D2 vendor+transport decision'. A mission with neither a run nor this reason is exactly the failure this record type exists to make impossible.

runAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of this run record's creation.

packManifestSha256.description: Required when runStatus is RUN. Points at the external-ai-pack actually sent.

verdictRecordKind.description: Required when runStatus is RUN and the mission produced an external-ai-verdict (M0-M3 security review, M6 audit). Restates the honesty-critical literal from the verdict record itself (see external-ai-verdict.schema.json) so a run record can never point at something that reads as a human sign-off.

recordKind.description: Alternative to verdictRecordKind for RUN missions that are not a security-review verdict at all (M5 cold-start authoring, M4 command-plan) -- a distinct, equally explicit literal so these can never be mistaken for a verdict/sign-off either. Exactly one of verdictRecordKind or recordKind is required when runStatus is RUN.

note.description: Free-text context on this RUN that the mission's own DoD isn't fully captured by runStatus alone -- e.g. M4's command-plan is RUN (a real vendor call happened) but the mission also requires executing that plan on a clean container/GH runner, which this note records as still outstanding rather than silently implying the mission fully closed.

vendors.description: Vendor(s) this run actually used, accumulated across every call ever ingested for this mission -- checked against the mission's vendorRequirements.minVendors.

vendor.description: The single vendor that produced THIS record (the most recent ingest) -- distinct from vendors above, which accumulates every vendor this mission has ever been run against.

model.description: The actual model identifier the platform configured and called (never a vendor's own self-report -- see build-review-pack.py's submit_pack_to_vendor).

details.description: Free-form, mission-shape-specific extra context that doesn't generalize across every mission (e.g. M4's commandPlanPath, M5's validationStatus/validationErrorCount) -- kept out of named top-level fields so this schema doesn't grow one bespoke property per mission shape.

findingsFiled.description: What happened to each finding after ingestion -- filed, never auto-applied (honesty rule 5).

registerRef.description: e.g. 'REG-42' -- where this finding was filed in the project's own register, if applicable (platform instance only).

reproductionStatus.description: P5's rule: every finding gets a RED-first local reproduction attempt before any fix. Unreproducible is filed UNCONFIRMED, never silently dismissed.

egressApproval.description: Records that sending this pack was an explicit publish action (honesty rule 6), not an implicit default.

scope.description: What was approved -- e.g. 'code excerpts only, per D3'.
